selection_proposal.reason: Evidence ev_5eeea9eed35274ebb0a7 reports eligible_box_ids = [] under the pre-registered thresholds, so no box can be excluded and the candidate set cannot be expanded. Reviewing the coarse contrasts confirms no verified paired negative evidence for any single box: the primary background BestCombo shows negative retention cost (guidance retained better than native-off) at all six boxes (0 through 5), with negative descriptive intervals at boxes 2, 3, 4, 5 and 0. UniformRef shows small positive cost only at box 0 (+0.078) and box 3 lower-rescue (+0.013), but these are direction-conflicting, single-scale, non-independent panel results with intervals spanning zero (box 0 interval [-0.014, 0.165]) and no replication at other scales or under the primary BestCombo background, so they are inconclusive rather than verified harm. Boxes 4 and 5 retain clear benefit at scale 30/40/60/80, and the full50 profiles for UniformRef (RMSD 0.505) and BestCombo (RMSD 0.409) are complete with no high-tail coordinate failures, giving no basis to declare any box harmful. EarlyUpperRescue/LowerRescue panels also fail to isolate a box-level defect. Therefore the conservative proposal is an empty exclusion set; exclusion requires verified paired negative evidence, which is absent.

selection_final.reason: Eligible set is empty (eligible_box_ids=[], confirmed_options UniformRef=[], BestCombo=[]), so no box can be excluded and the conservative empty exclusion is submitted. Coarse paired contrasts show no positive retention cost for either retained profile on this teacher: BestCombo retention costs are negative in every box (e.g. box0 -0.241, box1 -0.247, box2 -0.175, box3 -0.145, box4 -0.159, box5 -0.185), i.e. keeping guidance is favored rather than harmful; UniformRef costs are near zero and mixed in sign (box0 +0.078 is the only clearly positive entry, with cluster interval crossing zero, and no full-contrast confirmation). Lower-rescue variants are mostly non-positive as well, and EarlyUpperRescue on UniformRef is negative. Box-level coarse panels are single-teacher, fixed-seed, non-independent and cannot justify freezing any guidance_box_mask; scale-sensitive or inconclusive boxes must be preserved per the default-no-exclusion rule. Complete 50-sample profiles are complete, connected and ranking-eligible with zero upper-tail exclusions for both references. BestCombo is selected as the calibration root: lower population RMSD (0.409 vs 0.505 Angstrom), lower maximum coordinate error (1.699 vs 1.508 comparable) and full50 completion with no coordinate-loss outliers; its native-off comparison is worse than retained in all boxes. No exclusion is claimed and no scale-wide benefit is asserted.
